name: s81lk_rate_match

pin_regs.reason: two-clock CDC leaf: the recipe-3 pin register is single-clock (one data clock) and cannot serve both domains; the RTL already captures at the face in its own domain -- w_v/w_d are written straight into the 8x512 FIFO flops (wclk; the only logic before them is the IDLE/fill push decode), r_d is a flop output (rclk) and fault leaves the f1/f2 synchroniser flop. A pin register on the wclk side would add one recovered-clock edge only; on the rclk side it would delay the local beat by a cycle -- neither buys timing on a 43 um leaf.

structural_change: NEW leaf (ELEM-CENSUS 10-16, census class F, S-DIE ok 12:20): S81 link rate matcher ot_s81_rate_match (8-deep gray-pointer FIFO, recovered clock -> local clock, IDLE-beat drop at fill >= 6 / IDLE insert on empty, sticky fault on a lost data beat), real on-die digital sublayer inside BOTH ot_pdie_serdes and ot_pdie_ucie blackboxes (die_contracts.json two leaf rows, one master). Clocks: wclk = pma_rck (far die), rclk = local ck; plesiochronous (+-300 ppm, same nominal 833.333 ps). Timed as related_same_frequency (same_pll_fixed_phase 1/1 phase 0): every crossing (gray pointers, FIFO word -> r_d) gets ordinary one-cycle setup + hold, which bounds each crossing tighter than the gray FIFO needs; the async_gray_fifo admission is source-fingerprinted to the HBM FIFO only, and no false path / clock group is used. Outline from gate 1 (182141: ORFS synth 2,895 um2, placed std 3,324 um2 -> GPL util 104.9% in 43.2 x 86.4) re-sized to ~57% core util. S-DIE serdes/ucie macro boundary (physical/asap7_v41x_pdie_macros_v2/ot_pdie_serdes.lef, 250.056 x 2250.216 W/E link column, R0 = west column): PMA lanes / pads on the W (die-edge) face, the core-side beat bus on the E face (east column = MY mirror). w_v/w_d/wclk/wrst_n on W (from the KP4 decoder / UCIe PMA RX), r_d/fault/rclk/rrst_n on E (core-side rx bus).

job.purpose: S81 link rate-match leaf (one per SerDes and per UCIe link macro), never kitted before (census 10-16). Bench = standalone tb_s81_rate_match at +-1100 ppm both directions (24,000 data beats exact in order, no fault, 26 IDLE slips absorbed) + 2 source-copy mutants (data-beat drop, no IDLE insert).
